opportunity_semantics.attempts: pass_attempt AND NOT sack on eligible football plays; reconciliation to official QB counts audited, not assumed.
opportunity_semantics.ownership: passer GSIS, or rusher GSIS on scramble only; no name-based or participant starter inference.
opportunity_semantics.plays: Dropback OR non-kneel rush OR spike; scrambles count once; two-point/no-play excluded. Opportunity dropbacks add spikes (raw qb_dropback=0) to keep official attempts within the denominator.
opportunity_semantics.prior_cutoff: Earlier season/week AND source game-date +48h <= target game-date -24h at UTC00:00; corrected retrospective releases, not original provider vintages.
